facts.fact: The rider reports the lower door of the north-wall stair was opened with a key, not forced; Pritam's tracks run east up the cairn-light line Ila pencilled but never walked (the Meadow Cairn east bearing).
Captain Raghu's men's brass shoulder bells (not Raghu's own) were found in the snow beside Pritam's tracks.
Ila marks the east bearing as a dotted 'unknown way. Pritam.' on her private copy, and will add the same dotted mark and note to the queen's and Bhim's copies that night, still labelled unwalked.
Lata's drover came down off the pass and joined her mules in Kothi Shilak; Lata asks Meera who gave Pritam the key.
